# Euclase Monitor metrics wire format (vendored)

`euclase/metrics_wire.h` is a copy of the header-only EMS1 reader from
[Euclase Monitor](https://github.com/SemyonZamiakin/EuclaseMonitor) 1.1 (`include/euclase/metrics_wire.h`), MIT, same authors.
`adamant-view` uses it to read live per-core CPU load and RAM from the Corundum ring `/euclase-monitor`.
